build_exaone_moe_mtp_model: build an ExaoneMoe MTP model for multi-token prediction inference using vLLM configuration
create_multi_token_predictor: create an ExaoneMoeMultiTokenPredictor with vllm_config and optional prefix for multi-token generation
run_forward_pass_mtp: run the forward pass of ExaoneMoeMultiTokenPredictor with input_ids, positions, and hidden_states
load_model_weights: load and remap weights into ExaoneMoeMTP model including shared embed_tokens and lm_head parameters
compute_logits_mtp: compute logits from hidden_states using the ExaoneMoeMTP logits processor and lm_head
